svg.aria-label: The queue in submission order: frame N-1's command buffer, where pass A writes X and pass B reads X, then frame N's, where a barrier comes before pass A writes X again. Everything ahead of the barrier on the queue, last frame's command buffer included, is before the barrier; everything after it is after the barrier.
